credits_text:
BIGBELLYFILM PRESENTS A ROBERT P. OLSSON SHORT
AS THE INVESTIGATOR IN "MARCH THE 13TH 1941"
WRITTEN BY: BJORN-ERIK KARLSSON & ROBERT P. OLSSON
CINEMATOGRAPHER: KRISTOFFER ANDREN
FILM EDITORS: ULF NORSTROM & ROBERT P. OLSSON
MUSIC BY: JOHAN STRENDE SOUND: NORSTROM
PRODUCED AND DIRECTED BY ROBERT P. OLSSON
other_text: "MARCH THE 13TH. 1941" INSPIRED BY H.P. LOVECRAFT'S "THE STATEMENT OF RANDOLPH CARTER" "GREAT SOUND... THE JURY FOR FILMFORMEN (SWEDISH SHORT FILM FESTIVAL) "...conveys a sense of dread and scope central to Lovecraft's best work." CRAIG MULLINS www.unfilm.se
description: Poster features a bearded man in a dark setting with dramatic lighting, promoting a short film titled 'Somethings Waiting...' inspired by H.P. Lovecraft.
